summary.text: Uncover your face, keep still, check the lighting and camera, or contact the Singpass Helpdesk.

steps.name: Uncover your face
steps.text: Make sure your face is not covered while you scan.

items: Make sure your face is not covered.

steps.name: Keep still
steps.text: Keep still while the scan is in progress.

items: Keep still while scanning is in progress.

steps.name: Check the lighting
steps.text: Choose a place that is not too dark and has no strong lighting behind you.

items: Your environment is not too dark.
There is no strong lighting in the background.

steps.name: Check your camera
steps.text: Use a camera with a resolution of at least two megapixels. If you are using a laptop, try again using a mobile phone, which may have a better camera.

items: Use a camera with a minimum resolution of two megapixels.
If you are using a laptop, try again using a mobile phone, which has a better camera.

steps.name: Contact the Singpass Helpdesk
steps.text: If you need help with Singpass Face Verification, contact the Singpass Helpdesk directly.

items: If you require assistance with Singpass Face Verification, contact the Singpass Helpdesk directly.

example_phrasings: Why is Singpass Face Verification failing for me?
How can I get Face Verification to work?

sources.page_title: Why is Singpass Face Verification failing for me?

quotes.text: For ways to improve the success of Singpass Face Verification, you should ensure that:
You keep still while scanning is in progress
Your environment is not too dark
You use a minimum resolution of two megapixels for the camera.
If you require assistance with Singpass Face Verification, please contact the Singpass Helpdesk directly.
